evidence_notes.execution_semantics: Document adjusted-close construction, decision cutoff, timezone, corporate-action handling, and official-session endpoints. Unadjusted open and nonfill semantics belong to a later portfolio module.
evidence_notes.tradability_fields: Show non-degenerate ST and suspension behavior under historically effective vendor definitions. Price-limit, missing-open, and nonfill evidence is required only for a later portfolio module and does not authorize that unimplemented module.
evidence_notes.data_rights: Cite the contract or license terms permitting local analysis, public aggregate outputs, metadata, hashes, and publication of the exact official-calendar session dates embedded in the receipt.
evidence_notes.official_calendar: Retain authoritative SSE/SZSE provenance, resolve any disagreement, verify all endpoint and quote-date membership rules, and bind the exact CSV bytes.

chronology_contract.timezone_rule: Every timestamp must be finite ISO-8601 with an explicit UTC offset.
chronology_contract.mutation_rule: Any input-byte or evidence change after reviewed_at invalidates this attestation and requires a new review and hash.

signature.trust_boundary: Identity and evidence authenticity require independent human verification.

completion_gate: All required booleans must be true, all hashes must be 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters, all identities and timestamps must be complete, and status must become reviewed_pass before this artifact may enter the plan core.
